scripts.build: bun run build:app && bun run build:web && bun run build:workers
scripts.ci: bun run lint-full && bun run test && bun run --filter @orcai/web types:check && bun run build
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules dist apps/*/dist packages/*/dist .tanstack apps/*/.tanstack .devtools apps/*/.devtools **/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.lint: bun run --filter '*' paraglide:compile && biome check . && tsgo --build --noEmit --force tsconfig.json && bun run --filter @orcai/db check
scripts.lint-full: bun run --filter '*' paraglide:compile && biome check . && tsgo --build --noEmit --force tsconfig.json && bun run --filter @orcai/db check && bun run lint:eslint
scripts.lint:eslint: eslint apps/app && eslint apps/web && eslint apps/e2e apps/workers packages
scripts.test: bun run --filter '*' paraglide:compile && bun test --parallel --recursive packages/**/test/*.test.ts packages/**/test/**/*.test.ts scripts/*.test.ts && bun run --filter @orcai/app test
scripts.test:integration: bun run stack exec -- bun test --parallel $(find ./apps ./packages -name node_modules -prune -o -name '*.integration.ts' -print)
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run test
